integrity: Original neutral-set and ruin-probability ingredients are credited to Vega Coso (2026); new claims concern strict absorption-time optimization and the asymptotic latency contrast. No independent audit claimed.
scientific_limitations: Biased finite nearest-neighbor walks with two absorbing ends, all-rate reset-neutral iid interior distributions, fixed geometric reset probability and unit-time reset events; no relocation costs, no general reset-law optimality.
title: The unique fastest reset-neutral law for two-boundary geometric resetting
